choices: Use random.Random(22022) and 10000 paired batch-bootstrap draws.
Represent null effort as the output arm name 'ohne'.
Treat the supplied files as this experiment's data; reject unexpected models, cells, arms, positions, or call attempts rather than silently filtering.
For retries, use the highest recorded attempt (0, 1, or 2) for each batch/arm/position; do not pool attempts or select the most favorable attempt.

Judgments without an attempt field are treated as the final retained judgments. If judgments have attempt fields, use only the selected call's attempt. Reject mixtures of these formats within a batch/arm/position.
Collapse identical duplicate records; reject conflicting duplicates because the files do not otherwise identify which duplicate to use.

Require each complete batch to contain the same 12 item IDs in all four arms and all three positions, with consistent truth and slot assignments. Require both the selected call's parsed count and its observed nonmissing judgments to meet 95%. With 12 items, this requires all 12 judgments; missing judgments are not imputed or counted as errors.

Compute completion-token medians over selected final calls from complete batches only, giving every call equal weight and using the arithmetic midpoint for an even number of observations. Require valid token counts.
Average the three binary channel errors within each item, then average equally over eligible items, not equally over batch-specific rates.

Resample complete batches uniformly with replacement, drawing the original number of batches and keeping all arms, items, and positions together. Recompute item-weighted contrasts using the sampled batch multiplicities.
Use percentile bootstrap bounds: the 5th percentile for P1 and the 95th percentile for P2, with linear interpolation at index (n-1)*p.

Make exactly 10000 bootstrap draws when at least one batch is complete. For each contrast, omit bootstrap replicates with no items of its truth class from that contrast's quantile calculation; return null if undefined.
Return null for rates, estimates, medians, or bounds that cannot be calculated. Undefined conditions cannot confirm the hypothesis.
Below 16 complete batches, report bootstrap bounds only as descriptive uncertainty and force h_confirmed to false.
Use P1 estimate > 0 and lower bound > 0 for confirmation; +0.05 is a relevance benchmark, not an additional confirmation threshold. Use P2 upper bound <= 0.03.

Do not infer generator errors from unanimous alarms or automatically exclude them. These two files contain no documented manual adjudication, so report the analysis without generator-error exclusions; an adjudicated with-exclusion analysis cannot be reconstructed from these inputs.
